histories.name: space principals: a grant, notices, a principal out of force, cascades, a break and refused notices
histories.note: Members named T@R are the principal of space T at its grant rotation R, whose devices are those holding R's grant seed. A notice admits one; the rotation an event's sealed refs name puts out of force every principal of T whose rotation does not include it. Space wraps appear as wraps to the principal's devices. Refused notices stand for check_notice's NotGranteeMember, NoticeMismatch and NoticeStale; they admit nothing, and their events stand. A principal's inside devices are those still in T; T@T4's entitlement starts at P's response to T3, where f joined.
